text: Can you describe exactly how your cough feels, and does it produce any sputum? If so, what color is the sputum?

speaker: Patient
text: It's a persistent dry cough that doesn't bring up anything, not even a little bit. The irritation seems to get worse when I'm breathing hard or after I smoke. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Heart Failure with preserved or reduced ejection fraction presenting as cough and dyspnea.
